newsitem.title: PERU: Peru's July zinc output rises 7.3 percent.
newsitem.headline: Peru's July zinc output rises 7.3 percent.

text.p: Peru's zinc output rose 7.3 percent to 63,136 tonnes in July, compared with the same month last year, according to preliminary figures from the Energy and Mines Ministry released Thursday.
Production rose 6.3 percent to 422,457 tonnes in the first seven months of the year, compared with the same period last year, the ministry said.
In 1995, zinc output edged down 0.2 percent to 688,619 tonnes compared with 690,017 tonnes in 1994.
Peru is the world's fourth largest zinc producer. State-run mining giant Centromin Peru is the country's largest producer of the metal.
